# WHAT GOES ON THE WEBSITE — the one list (2026-10-19)
#
# GitHub publishes therailroster.com from this repo. Only the paths marked
# "publish:" are copied onto the site (by .github/workflows/publish-site.yml);
# everything marked "private:" stays in the repo only. Every top-level file and
# folder must be on this list exactly once — tests/site_files_tests.js fails
# when a new one is added without deciding which it is.

# The sales page and its pieces
publish: index.html
publish: site
publish: terms
publish: privacy
publish: preview-1051ec16
# The app
publish: app
# The old root service worker — unregisters itself on browsers that installed
# the app before it moved to /app/ (keep until no one has the old install)
publish: sw.js
# Data records — read from the live site during master-list edits
publish: harvests
# Google: search listing + Search Console proof (never remove the proof file)
publish: robots.txt
publish: sitemap.xml
publish: google540af0b13abd3cff.html
# The custom domain name
publish: CNAME

# Working files — never on the website
private: tests
private: tools
private: README.md
private: PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.md
private: LICENSE
private: package.json
private: package-lock.json
private: .github
private: .gitignore
private: .nojekyll
